hints.text: To fill a box you stack layers of unit cubes. How many cubes are in one layer, and how many layers are there?
Multiply the three numbers $2 \times 4 \times 5$. You could do $2 \times 4 = 8$ first and then multiply by $5$.
$8 \times 5 = 40$, so the volume of the box is $40$ cubic units.

explanation: Use the volume formula for a box: $V = 2 \times 4 \times 5$.
Multiply the first two dimensions to get one layer: $2 \times 4 = 8$.
Multiply by the third dimension for all the layers: $8 \times 5 = 40$.
The volume of the box is $40$ cubic units.
